dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: When people at the Akademiya included me in a group photo, they would also send me a copy.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: I have zero interest in group photos, but I also wouldn't just throw them away. I stored them all in a box.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: After coming back yesterday, I looked through them and found one with Abattouy. I gave it to Karkata, and it seemed happy... That's good enough.

dialogues.speaker: Early Photo
dialogues.text: The photo that was put aside...

dialogues.speaker: Early Photo
dialogues.text: (One of the many group photos. Tighnari always has the same expression and doesn't seem to be interested in taking pictures.)

dialogues.speaker: Early Photo
dialogues.text: (A photo of Tighnari and Abattouy. Abattouy had a bright smile in this one.)
